design.mood: A sophisticated fusion of scientific archival clarity and high-end tech-forward minimalism.
design.motion: Slow-burn parallax on 3D objects that syncs with scroll depth. Buttons and UI elements utilize micro-scale springs and subtle opacity reveals to emphasize tactile quality.
guardrails: Avoid overly heavy shadows or skeuomorphic containers for UI.
Do not use serif typefaces; stick to high-contrast grotesque sans.
Prevent text from overlapping 3D elements unless it utilizes a clear 'layered' parallax effect.
Ensure buttons never lose their rounded, pill-shaped geometry.
design.layout: Minimalist full-bleed sections with generous negative space. Content is centered vertically with a rhythmic use of macro-typography and small-scale functional UI elements (pills, icons).

typography.display: General Sans or Robust Sans-Serif, Semi-Bold, large-scale (macro).
typography.mono: JetBrains Mono or SF Mono for navigational labels and bracketed numbering.
typography.body: Inter or Helvetica Neue, Regular, tight tracking.

design.centerpiece: High-fidelity 3D skeletal assets with realistic textures contrasted against ultra-clean white backgrounds.
